title: You're offline
required_copy: No traffic is going through your connection
body_lines: This device isn't sharing right now.
No traffic is going through your connection.

reason_lines.endpoint_mismatch: This device's sharing key doesn't match how it was set up. Set up sharing again on this device to keep going.
reason_lines.endpoint_bind_required: This device's sharing key doesn't match how it was set up. Set up sharing again on this device to keep going.
reason_lines.connection_lost: The connection dropped. Check your internet, then turn sharing back on.
reason_lines.egress_off: Pilot sharing is switched off right now. We'll show you online again when it's back on.
reason_lines.egress_state_stale: Pilot sharing is switched off right now. We'll show you online again when it's back on.
reason_lines.egress_budget_exceeded: You've reached today's sharing limit. Sharing starts again tomorrow.
reason_lines.egress_allowlist_mismatch: This device needs an update before it can share. Update the app, then turn sharing back on.
reason_lines.relay_path_required: Sharing stopped because the connection left its expected secure route. Turn sharing back on to reconnect.

rules: Never show raw reason codes to the user; map to reason_lines
Turning sharing back on still requires P1 ack + P2 consent on record
Distinct from P4: P4 is user-paused, P8 is stopped by the system
Unknown reason codes fall back to connection_lost
